formPane uses semi-transparent background (lines 477-485): __alphaColor(T.bg, T.isDark ? '36' : '40') with backdrop blur
formScroll no longer paints opaque T.bg background - allows image to show through
Dark theme overlay: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.52) 0%, rgba(15,23,42,0.36) 42%, rgba(15,23,42,0.50) 100%)
Form card, labels, inputs, CTA, and brand panel all remain legible with proper contrast in both themes
